About the Red Hot Ladies Roving Ride group ride

A women's riding group under the Hawaii Bicycling League. The Sunday Roving Ride is a moderate no-drop ride of 20 to 50 miles with a rotating start; the Cruisers and Cosmos rides the same morning are shorter, beginner-friendly options. Contact the leader for the week's start.

It's a no-drop ride. If you're slower than the group, someone waits. That's the whole point of a group ride.
